## Course notes

### Mathematical Logic (Licence 2)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="30%"}
[![Cover of the Mathematical Logic course](images/logique-couverture.jpg){.course-cover}](files/logique-mathematique-L2-extrait.pdf)

::: {.column width="70%"}
*From language to proof.* Lecture notes with tutorial exercises for second-year Licence students in Mathematics. Four chapters: mathematical language and reasoning; set theory; propositional calculus and predicate calculus; well-ordering and induction. Academic year 2026–2027. Unpublished.

### Measure and Integration

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="30%"}
[![Cover of Au-delà de Riemann](images/au-dela-de-riemann-couverture.jpg){.course-cover}](files/au-dela-de-riemann-extrait.pdf)
:::
::: {.column width="70%"}
*Au-delà de Riemann : Mesure, intégration et passage à la limite.* Abdelhalim Azzouz and Kouider Djerfi. SARAHMED Éditions, 2026.

A course for Licence 3 and Master 1, in six chapters: $\sigma$-algebras and measures; measurable functions and random variables; integrable functions and the Lebesgue integral; product measures and iterated integrals; $L^p$ spaces; density, convolution and the Hilbert space $L^2$.

[Cover, contents and references (PDF)](files/au-dela-de-riemann-extrait.pdf){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
::::

#### Lecture slides — Measure and Integration (Licence 3)

**Academic year 2026–2027.** Four chapters and 14 Beamer sessions covering sigma-algebras and measures, measurable functions, Lebesgue integration, and product measures. The complete **French-English-language** course comprises 432 slides, including definitions, proofs, worked examples, and exercises.

**French version:** [View the original 14-session slideshow](slides-mesure-integration.qmd).

**English version, sessions 1–14:** [Read the slides online](slides-mesure-integration-en.qmd).
